description: FDA Drugs@FDA approved applications (openFDA) by active ingredient: application number, sponsor, brand names, dosage form, marketing status and Orange Book therapeutic equivalence (TE) code. Up to 10 applications per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_fda_purple_book when you need FDA Purple Book licensed biological products matching; health_fda_adverse_events_faers when you need FDA FAERS drug adverse event reports for a generic drug. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
